newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close at record level on Bank freedom.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close at record level on Bank freedom.

text.p: Leading shares soared to their highest-ever levels on Tuesday, amid euphoria over the new British government's decision to grant the Bank of England freedom to set interest rates without political interference.

Labour's new Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown's decision to grant the BoE a level of independence was well received by market professionals, still uncertain about how tough a party last in power 18 years ago, would be on inflation and monetary policy.
The FTSE 100 Index closed 63.7 points higher to a record closing level of 4,519.3.
